title: Exploring Momentum Transfer in Electron Microscopy: Size and Material Effects on Nanoparticle Resonances
content: The interaction of electron beams with matter plays a crucial role in the advances of electron microscopy techniques, offering atomic-scale spatial resolution and femtosecond temporal scales [1–4]. Beyond imaging, electron beams can manipulate samples, including the transfer of angular momentum to nanoparticles (NPs) [5–8].
